name: External Reporting Source 1 Code
definition: Specifies the reporting source, as published in an external reporting source code list.|External code sets can be downloaded from www.iso20022.org.

ACCT.name: Accounting
ACCT.definition: Statement or Report is based on accounting data.

ARPF.name: Account Reconciliation System Full
ARPF.definition: An account reconciliation system that provides full reconciliation that usually addresses checks

ARPP.name: Account Reconciliation System Partial
ARPP.definition: An account reconciliation system that provides partial reconciliation that usually addresses checks

CTDB.name: Controlled Disbursement System
CTDB.definition: A sub-application that reports presentment totals

CUST.name: Custody
CUST.definition: Statement or Report is based on custody data.

DPCS.name: Deposit Concentration System
DPCS.definition: Deposit system that reports what has been collected from various financial institutions

LKBX.name: Lockbox
LKBX.definition: Processing system that captures and reports check data in a lockbox environment.

RCPT.name: Receipts
RCPT.definition: A system that reports consolidated remittance information obtained from various , i.e., ACH, wires, lockbox, etc.

MIBO.name: MI Back Office
MIBO.definition: Transaction submitted directly from PMI (Payment Market Infrastructure back-office system).

PFRE.name: Participant Front End
PFRE.definition: Transactions submitted directly from participant / PSO (Payment System Operator) applications.
